# [EPIC] Vercel Frontend & 1-Click Cloud Orchestration

## Epic
Provide a seamless, zero-friction way to showcase Filmpire Microservices live in a portfolio on Vercel, with an in-app Admin Deploy Control Center to spin up and tear down the cloud backend (Azure AKS / AWS k3s) or local Docker/Minikube Cloudflare Tunnel on demand, automatically linking them via Dynamic DNS with $0 cost protection.

## Business Value
Allows effortless, impressive live demonstrations of the microservices architecture during portfolio reviews and technical interviews while upholding the hard $0 cloud spend constraint.

## Product Goal alignment
Directly serves the Product Goal /docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md: 'disciplined enough to defend in a technical interview — built at $0 real cost.'

- [x] #137 — a 1-click cloud deploy dashboard

## Notes
All child Stories are closed and verified. Enables zero-friction live demonstrations of the Filmpire Microservices portfolio on Vercel via cloud VMs (Azure/AWS) or local Cloudflare Tunneling (Docker/Minikube).
